about: Lot -> best library layout (one MW source per lot). Key = lot id of the coverage file. best = the fitting layout with the most MW (ties: fits more lots, then fewer storeys); its MW, storey-1 footprint, storeys, outdoor generators and yard come from the library export. "no layout fits" = the Engineering cards keep their own sizing, labelled "rough size, no layout fits this lot". Generated by from the live kept set; regenerate after every rebuild. Lots the rebuilt library does not cover keep their old-library layout, marked oldLibrary and noted "Old library: being rebuilt" .
